subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should this draft remain a combined proof stack, and what baseline should Mantis use to prove the generated-media wake-false fallback?
rationale: The default workflow baseline is the PR base SHA, while the marker/env fault-injection hook is introduced by the candidate diff; deciding the proof topology and final split boundary is a maintainer proof policy choice.

options.title: Fix Proof Topology First
options.body: Keep the draft open but require the baseline to include the harness-only wake-false injection, or move the injection into workflow-owned proof tooling applied to both worktrees, before relying on Mantis evidence.

options.title: Accept Source-Level Proof Only
options.body: Maintainers may decide scheduler-level tests are enough for this internal path and stop treating the Telegram proof stack as a merge prerequisite.

options.title: Close The Stack And Use Split PRs
options.body: If combined proof is not worth the extra boundary risk, close this draft and continue reviewing the linked implementation and harness PRs separately.

recommendation.title: Fix Proof Topology First
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open but require the baseline to include the harness-only wake-false injection, or move the injection into workflow-owned proof tooling applied to both worktrees, before relying on Mantis evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is primarily about Telegram proof-runner topology, and recent history ties this owner to the relevant proof harness path.
